title: Pip and the Trail of Ten Acorns
moral: When we wonder, ask questions and look closely, we discover wonderful things.
description: BONK! A little acorn bounces off Pip's nose, and the curious fox just HAS to find out where it came from! Follow the acorn trail with Pip, Tumble and Hazel through Clover Wood and count from one all the way to ten in this funny animated story about curiosity, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: One crunchy autumn morning, Pip the fox opened his front door and... BONK! Something small and brown bounced right off his nose!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Ooh! What is it? A teeny brown egg? A tiny football?
Tee-hee! No, silly Pip! It was an acorn! ONE little acorn!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Where did you come from, little acorn? I just HAVE to find out!

narration.text: Pip zoomed down the path. Zip! And there was another acorn!
Whoops! Pip's paw rolled on it. Wibble-wobble... BUMP! Right onto his fluffy tail!

narration.text: HONK! Are you okay, Pip? Oh look, there's one more acorn!
How many acorns have they found now? Let's count! One, two, three...
THREE acorns! Hooray! You're a super counter!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Maybe acorns fall from the clouds, like raindrops!
Tee-hee! No, Tumble! Acorns grow on big oak trees!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: I spy with my little eye... two more acorns, hiding in the leaves!
HONK! went Tumble's trunk. BOING! went Hazel's prickles! Four... five! FIVE acorns!

narration.text: By the bubbly stream they found acorn number six! And number seven sat way up high, on top of a tall post.
Pip jumped. BOING! Too short! Pip jumped again. BOING! Still too short!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Third time... super-duper JUMP!
BONK! Pip bumped the post... and the acorn plopped right onto Tumble's head! Seven!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! Got it!

narration.text: Up, up, up the windy hill! Pip found acorn number eight!
Then Hazel spotted ONE more. Eight and one more makes... how many? Can you count?
NINE acorns! You're so clever!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I know who dropped them! A giant, hungry dino-saurus!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: A dino-SNORE-us? Shhh... I can hear snoring!

narration.text: Under the giant oak tree sat... Nana Hoot! Fast asleep! Hoo... zzzz... Hoo... zzzz...
Her acorn sack had a hole in it! Out rolled one more acorn. Plip! Right onto Tumble's trunk. That makes TEN!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO!
Whoooosh! Nana's glasses flew up, up, up... and landed on Pip's nose!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Hoo-hoo-HOO! Oh dear, where are my acorns?

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I picked ten acorns to plant ten new oak trees. But my sack had a hole!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Don't worry, Nana! We followed the trail, and we found them all!
So the friends gave every acorn back. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, TEN!
And Tumble tied the sack up tight with his strong trunk. No more holes!

narration.text: Then everybody helped Nana plant the acorns in a long, long row. Dig, drop, pat!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Me first! Dig-dig-dig-dig-DIG!
SPLOOSH! Mud flew up... and landed right on Tumble's cap! Tee-hee!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Let's count the holes! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten!
TEN holes for ten acorns! Perfect!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: You were so curious, Pip! You asked questions, you looked closely, and you found every acorn.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: And one day, there will be ten giant oak trees! Super-duper!
Then Nana's glasses slipped down her beak again. Hoo-hoo-HOO! And everyone did a wiggly acorn dance!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! I mean... YAY!
